name: The best parts for AI intelligence, assembled and proven
vision_statement: AI builders have consistent interfaces for whatever the current best AI solutions are, to adapt only what is unique to their project.
opportunities: Any product that needs an AI grounded in a person or team's own goals can start from the assembled whole instead of researching and gluing parts again; a production consumer is the hardest test of the assembly.
solution_coherence: The AI Hub of Hubs gives anyone a working AI assembled from measured open-source parts, and The Self is the whole that keeps its five kinds of part working as one. To respond to a request, The Self asks Consciousness for the person's authority and preferences, asks Body where the system's data lives, and passes the request to Intelligence, which draws tools, models and outside knowledge from World. The Self then keeps the run record in Body, has Integrity audit it, and asks Consciousness to learn from the person's feedback. When asked for its health, The Self reports on itself, and for the research it asks World how current it is.
